paragraphs.text: The Dawning Archaic is an Archaic avatar from Arcavios . According to Jadzi , this Archaic is formed from the soul of what will be the last-ever Oracle.

The Dawning Archaic is massive even for an archaic. Star arches and miniature galaxies hover around their head like a jeweled crown. They are the last of their kind, the final Oracle of Arcavios reborn. Rivers of glowing, indescribable color are visible in the creases of their flesh.

After a mysterious force began to disrupt the natural flow of time across Arcavios, the Dawning Archaic suffered the consequences most severely. Torn loose from the steady currents of mana and chronology, they exist in a state of instability, wracked by painful paradoxes and temporal dissonance that warp both their form and their behavior.

During the fall semester of 4565 AR , the Dawning Archaic appeared in Titan's Grave and kidnapped Oracle Jadzi . After being attacked by Chandra Nalaar , they fell into a chamber within the titan containing a nexus of wild energy. Jadzi attempted a ritual to calm the Archaic, but was disrupted by Chandra continuing her assault. While attempting to calm them again, Jadzi was pushed into the nexus by the Quandrix mage-student Tamira , causing her to disappear from reality. With the chaos threatening to spiral out of control and kill them all, Witherbloom mage-student Lluwen was forced to finish the ritual himself, calling upon all his friends as well as the Lumarets to encase the Archaic in the force of their unity and stop their rampage.
